The '''Seerdon Campaign''' or '''Kohl Seerdon Crisis''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] campaign against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kohl Seerdon]]'s efforts to steal the Alliance's store of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]]. It was undertaken by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

==History==
After the defection of [[Kasan Moor/Legends|Kasan Moor]] to the Rebellion, Rogue Squadron conducted a [[Battle above Taloraan|raid]] on the [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] mining colony of [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]] in Seerdon's territory. They caused much damage to the Imperial operations there, and left before reinforcements arrived.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />

The Rogues then participated with the [[Escape from Fest|theft]] of Seerdon's [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|AT-PTs]] and the plundering of his research facility. Again, the raid was swift.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />

In retaliation, Seerdon [[Blockade on Chandrila|blockaded]] the planet of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. Rogue Squadron escorted a hovertrain carrying supplies to the city. The Rogues' mission was a complete success.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />

Seerdon then set lured Rogue Squadron into a [[Raid on Sullust|fient]] on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. The Rogues destroyed a power station in the system successfully, but the entire thing was a ruse set up to draw the squadron away from his [[Attack on Thyferra|attack]] on the [[Bacta/Legends|Bacta]] producing word of [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]]. The Rogues caught wind of the ruse and recaptured Thyferra. Seerdon was killed in the battle.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />
